title: v0.44.0-nightly.20260515 - RAG debugging, auth fixes, and proxy improvements
description: Exposed RAG snippets to local log file for debugging, prevented conflicting credentials on enterprise gateways with optional API keys support, respected NO_PROXY for network-based MCP servers, resolved permission denied in sandbox on NixOS, preserved new line at end of edit window, ensured Vertex AI sets hasAccessToPreviewModels, stabilized admin settings comparison to prevent restart loop, updated vulnerable dependencies, resolved EISDIR errors during file processing, clarified env var sanitization policy for MCP, added ENAMETOOLONG and ENOTDIR to exceptions for file parsing errors, explicitly cleared entrypoint when spawning sandbox container, updated sandbox image command, externalized https-proxy-agent to fix proxy support.

title: v0.44.0-nightly.20260514 - Agent refactor, Auto mode merge, and OAuth improvements
description: Incremental refactor of repo agent towards skills-based composition, fixed line wrap padding for selection lists, updated read_file schema for v1 compatibility, configured git remote with token for authentication, merged Auto modes into a single Auto mode, preserved OAuth refresh tokens during rotation and retrieval, allowed keychain auth for --list-sessions and non-interactive mode, handled EISDIR on virtual drives in memory discovery, auto-approved shell redirections in AUTO_EDIT mode, refreshed MCP OAuth token usage after re-auth, clamped table column widths, isolated subagent thread context, made context files append instead of replace, added system PATH fallback for ripgrep resolution, cleaned up launched memory features, throttled shell text output and bounded live UI buffer, prevented crash when @-mention captures non-path blob, ensured stable fallback for restricted preview models.

title: Version 2.1.150 - Internal infrastructure improvements
description: Internal infrastructure improvements with no user-facing changes.

title: Version 2.1.149 - Multiple improvements and fixes
description: Added `/usage` per-category breakdown, `/diff` keyboard scrolling, GFM task list checkbox rendering, enterprise managed setting for cloud MCP connectors, and multiple security fixes including PowerShell permission bypass and sandbox write allowlist fixes.

title: Version 2.1.148 - Bash tool fix
description: Fixed Bash tool returning exit code 127 on every command for some users (regression from 2.1.147).

title: Version 2.1.147 - Background sessions and renamed /simplify
description: Pinned background sessions now stay alive when idle, `/simplify` renamed to `/code-review` with new correctness bug reporting functionality, improved auto-updater with retry logic and better error reporting, and improved diff rendering performance.

title: v0.42.0-nightly.20260512 - Context improvements and routing fixes
description: Changed snapshotter model config, allowed installing extensions from ssh repo, prevented duplicate SessionStart systemMessage render, prevented infinite thought loop in ACP mode by disabling nextSpeakerCheck, used static tool name in confirmation prompt to avoid parsing errors, refactored tool turn handling in NumericalClassifierStrategy to prevent 400 Bad Request, handled malformed projects.json in ProjectRegistry, added gutter width to input prompt width calculation, prevented EISDIR crash when customIgnoreFilePaths contains directories, allowed Enter to select session while in search mode in /resume, enabled adk non-interactive session, restored resume for legacy sessions, respected explicit model selection after Flash quota exhaustion, introduced adaptive token calculator to more accurately calculate content sizes, updated checkout action configuration in workflows, injected quota_project_id to prevent fallback to default oauth client, excluded extension context from skill extraction agent, enabled NumericalRouter when using dynamic model configs, actively triaged missing priority labels and cleaned up conflicting labels, introduced SubagentState enum for progress.

title: Version 2.1.145 - Agent view improvements
description: Added `claude agents --json` for scripting, status line JSON input now includes GitHub repo/PR info, plugin discover/browse screens show component inventory before installation, and numerous fixes.
